$comment: GENERATED by `npm run gen:contracts` from the catalogue, the recipe, spec/figma-components.json and the repo. Never edit by hand.
label: Split Button
description: A main action joined to a menu of related alternatives. A ButtonGroup of two segments (the action with its label and leading icon, and an icon-only caret) over a DropdownMenu that opens below, aligned to the end edge. It paints nothing of its own: the segments are ButtonGroupItems (Action/primary or Action/secondary, Radius/action, Shadow/xs) and the menu is the DropdownMenu of the same size (xs opens sm), 8px below the group (Spacing/gap-control) and 256 wide. Open pins the caret Active and swaps CaretDown for CaretUp. Motion: the menu grows out of the caret on popover-enter (use-disclosure-in), its rows arrive one after another on use-stagger-in, and it leaves on popover-exit; the main half never scales, and reduced motion keeps only the fade.

props.name: variant
props.description: Brand or neutral fill, inherited from ButtonGroup (Action/primary · Action/secondary and their paired ink).

props.name: size
props.description: Size/control-md 40 · xs 24 · sm 32 · lg 48; the menu is the DropdownMenu of the same size (xs opens sm).

props.name: open
props.description: Figma Open: the menu is open and the caret is Active (controlled).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the caret, Escape or a pick opens or closes the menu.

props.name: children
props.description: The main segment's label (the nested item's Label).

props.name: menu
props.description: The menu rows (Content slot); a critical row is Variant=critical. Defaults to the file's three.

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: The caret's accessible name. Defaults to "<label> more actions".

usage: Use in toolbars and page headers when one action is primary and a few related ones sit behind it (Publish · Publish and notify · Save as draft). One per toolbar; risky actions go in the menu as critical rows. Use Button when there is a single action, and a DropdownMenu on an IconButton when none is primary. The pair never collapses: give it its own row on narrow screens.
accessibility: Two native <button>s. The caret is labelled "<label> more actions" with aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded; the menu is a Radix DropdownMenu (arrows move and loop, typeahead, Escape closes and returns focus to the caret). The main segment is a plain action: no aria-pressed. In Dark the default Variant's label is light on the violet fill and is judged by perceived contrast (APCA), as on Button: a WCAG checker reads about 4.0:1 there by design.
